info.title: SqlDataPack.Cli
info.description: Command line tool for SqlDataPack. Exports a slice of a SQL Server database into a single SQLite file and imports it back, without writing any code. Pick the tables, columns and rows that come out, edit the file with plain SQL, then load it into a dev or test database or hand it to someone who has no access to the source.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Export a slice of a SQL Server database into a single SQLite file, and import it back.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a slice of a SQL Server database into a single SQLite file.

options.name: --connection
options.description: SQL Server connection string. Falls back to the SQLDATAPACK_CONNECTION environment variable, which keeps it out of shell history.

options.name: --out
options.description: Path of the SQLite package to write.

options.name: --tables
options.description: Only export these tables, as schema.Table. Repeat the flag or separate with commas.

options.name: --exclude-tables
options.description: Export every table except these. Cannot be combined with --tables.

options.name: --exclude-column
options.description: Leave a column out of the package entirely, as schema.Table.Column. An excluded column is never read from SQL Server. Repeatable.

options.name: --global-where
options.description: Row filter applied to every exported table holding the named column, as "Column:predicate". A table without the column exports unfiltered with a warning. Repeatable.

options.name: --table-where
options.description: Row filter for one table, as "schema.Table:predicate". Repeatable.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Capture the source schema as a dacpac alongside the data, so import can recreate it. none (default) or dacpac.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Rows per batch. Defaults to 1,000.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: SQL command timeout in seconds.

options.name: --options
options.description: JSON file describing everything the flags do not cover. Explicit flags win over the file. It must not contain a connection string.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress per-table progress. Warnings and errors are still reported. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print a stack trace when the tool fails unexpectedly. [default: False]

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import a SQLite package produced by export back into SQL Server.

options.name: --connection
options.description: SQL Server connection string. Falls back to the SQLDATAPACK_CONNECTION environment variable, which keeps it out of shell history.

options.name: --deploy-schema
options.description: Deploy the dacpac embedded in the package before loading data. none (default) or dacpac. Requires the package to have been exported with --schema dacpac.

options.name: --row-count-drift
options.description: What to do when the package holds a different number of rows than the export recorded, which is what editing the file does. warn (default) imports what is there; fail rejects the package before writing anything.

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Rows per batch. Defaults to 1,000.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Bulk copy timeout in seconds. The separate validation timeout is available in the options file.

options.name: --options
options.description: JSON file describing everything the flags do not cover. Explicit flags win over the file. It must not contain a connection string.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress per-table progress. Warnings and errors are still reported. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print a stack trace when the tool fails unexpectedly. [default: False]
